opennyai_summary.decision:
3. The petitioner is aggrieved by the quantum of compensation awarded to him for the land acquired under the Patna High Court CWJC No.17007 of 2016(2) dt.08-04-2025 National Highways Act,
1956.
The petitioner may take the recourse of statutory authority, provided under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
5. With these observations, the writ petition stands disposed of.
